Recursive CLD products give E'=int(b-a)MA(a_t), E''=-2Q_theta_at(b-a), tangent concavity and the exact midpoint gain I(a,b)/8. Coordinate comparison/calibration gives a<=a(Gauss(tau)), normalized Gauss values[-1/2,0], theta^2=2LebesgueGauss; actual finite grids and full-point atoms give the moduli. Psi_C(I)=I/2+sqrt(42CI), H_C=Omega_C+sqrt(6C)(sqrt I+sqrt Psi_C), T_C=Omega_C+2sqrt(6C)sqrt Psi_C. Universal maximizing-tail coercivity is C_mu=(sqrt(6B)+sqrt(10B+8))^2/4. Exact midpoint gives I(a,b)<=4(epsilon_a+epsilon_b) across ALL maximizing families. Dense bounded tests and Riesz yield canonical real/moving moments and genuine weak MA limit nu, D(nu)=e-p, int a_n nu->p, int a_n mu->r=e-B, K=B-D(nu)>=0. A fast actual sequence has ordinary open O_m with Cap_(C+k)(O_m)<=(8/7)2^-3m, N=intersection O_m null for every bounded MA/mixed measure and fixed-sublevel weak limit, and no full point in N. Its Borel u=limsup a_n is finite/continuous on each closed complement, with uniform error2^(1-n). Tonelli supplies bounded-MA integral tails; finite actual maxima have small energy/I errors. Full dual followed by sequential dominated/monotone convergence gives u integrable against EVERY prescribed mu, int(S_j-u)mu->0, int(a_j-u)+mu->0 and int|a_j-u|mu->J=intu mu-(e-B)>=0. Its finite-max objective loss is exactly J. These calculations assign neither positivity to the LSC S_j nor MA to the Borel u. Actual decreasing generated presentations have canonical energy/MA by compact strict domination, finite cubic coefficient convergence and dense-test/Riesz construction, but no new presentation is manufactured. The ordinary USC relaxation R is canonical by the all-affinoid Shilov formula.
